title: From an Ad to a Visit
subtitle: A campaign result with supporting records you can check.
metaDescription: Follow fictional travelers, inspect the evidence behind an attribution decision, and detect edits to a signed campaign blockchain.
imageAlt: Illustrative mountain landscape for fictional Cedar Valley Tourism
problem: Campaign results need a checkable connection to their evidence, not only a reported total.
task: Keep a quiet five-traveler simulation while explaining attribution and tamper-evident recordkeeping.
actions: Kept overlapping traveler lanes and individual replacement within a simpler two-panel layout.
Separated reported visits from a computed attribution decision with explicit evidence and an example 30-day rule.
Added inline explanations, supporting-record links, record-derived totals, and editable-copy verification.
results: A visit can be recorded without receiving campaign credit; a website visit is not required.
Changes to attribution evidence, rules or credit fail verification without changing original campaign totals.
notes: Unlisted, browser-local educational blockchain. All people, occurrence dates and outcomes are fictional. Local signatures verify bytes and rule consistency, not independent consensus or marketing causation.
